data.name: Witch of Ice Kingdom Ⅱ
data.detailed_description:
Description:

「Witch of Ice Kingdom Ⅱ」is a retro JRPG. The storyline is brief also contain rich. And there are hidden events waiting for you to find. You will play as a little witch waking up on the bed. She was remembering various events......You will visit places such as the royal castle, the snow mountain cave, the white forest and even more of dangerous locations! The battle in the game adopt Turn-Based Combat. In battle, the little witch can only use magic, and the "Attack" select of her is invalid. But she can consume 1 point of MP to summon pumpkins.


Storyline:

There was a war between Witch happened in the beautiful Exlester Continent. It was terminated by a brave with archangel descent, but because of strong magic effect, the Exlester Continent became into a permanent state of winter. However, after becoming the permanent state of winter, the people live in the mainland always suffer a called “Crazy Winter” disturbance. Until that day, the Crazy Winter coming. The seal of Witch was undone. In the white Exlester Continent, there was a kingdom named Carripardo, and the story begins here...... This story is set after the Crazy Winter , launching a new adventure by the little Witch Nonoly.

data.short_description: The Exlester Continent had once been a beautiful land. But it was destroyed ruthlessly by a war between witches. At last a hero of the Archangel decedent put the war to an end by sealing the power of those witches. But it was too late, By the mighty magic, The beautiful Exlester Continent Was into the winter forever.

reviews.review:
Witch of Ice Kingdom II is a fantasy role-playing game developed by Windward_Birds and published by XNZONE. Built around a classic RPG framework, the game delivers a compact adventure that blends magical storytelling, exploration, and traditional turn-based battles. Rather than chasing modern trends, it embraces the charm of old-school role-playing games, offering an experience that feels inspired by the era when narrative and atmosphere were often more important than technical spectacle.

The story takes place on the frozen Exlester Continent, a land permanently scarred by an ancient conflict between powerful witches. Generations after that devastating war, the world remains trapped in an endless winter, creating a setting filled with mystery and melancholy. Players step into the role of Nonoly, a young witch whose journey gradually reveals forgotten truths about the continent and the strange return of magical forces that threaten the fragile peace. The narrative unfolds through exploration, character interactions, and discoveries scattered throughout the world, giving players a reason to continue pushing deeper into the icy wilderness.

One of the game's strongest qualities is its setting. The frozen landscapes, snow-covered forests, mountain caves, and royal structures create a consistent atmosphere that supports the story's themes. While the visual presentation relies on simple pixel-art assets, the environments successfully convey the feeling of traveling through a magical land trapped in perpetual cold. The world feels handcrafted with care, and its locations often encourage players to search for secrets and hidden events that expand the lore beyond the main storyline.

Combat follows a familiar turn-based format that will be instantly recognizable to fans of traditional Japanese RPGs. Battles are easy to understand but include a few mechanics that give them their own identity. Because Nonoly is a witch, she cannot rely on standard physical attacks, forcing players to focus on magical abilities instead. The option to summon pumpkins through the use of MP introduces an additional layer of strategy, requiring players to carefully manage resources during longer encounters. Although the battle system does not offer extensive complexity, it remains enjoyable thanks to its thematic consistency and straightforward design.

The progression system is equally accessible. Players travel through various regions, battle enemies, collect rewards, and gradually become stronger while uncovering more of the story. The game does not overwhelm players with complicated mechanics or endless customization options. Instead, it maintains a focused structure that allows the adventure to move at a steady pace. This approach makes the game particularly welcoming for players who prefer narrative-driven RPGs rather than heavily system-focused experiences.

Another notable aspect is the game's pacing. Witch of Ice Kingdom II avoids unnecessary padding and keeps its adventure relatively concise. The story advances regularly, new locations appear at a comfortable rate, and the game rarely feels burdened by excessive grinding. This makes it a good choice for players seeking a shorter role-playing experience that can be completed without a major time investment. However, the compact length may leave some players wishing for deeper character development or additional side content, as several interesting ideas could have benefited from further expansion.

The presentation succeeds most when viewed through the lens of a nostalgic RPG. The pixel graphics, classic interface design, and traditional structure evoke memories of role-playing games from previous generations. While the visuals are limited compared to contemporary releases, they effectively support the fantasy atmosphere. The soundtrack also contributes positively by reinforcing both the magical and mysterious elements of the adventure, helping players become immersed in the frozen world and its lingering secrets.

Overall, Witch of Ice Kingdom II is a charming independent RPG that understands its strengths. It offers an engaging fantasy story, a memorable winter-themed setting, accessible turn-based combat, and a sense of adventure that appeals to fans of classic role-playing games. Its modest scope prevents it from reaching the heights of larger genre releases, but its heartfelt storytelling and atmospheric world make it a worthwhile experience for players who appreciate traditional RPG design. Those looking for a focused fantasy journey filled with magic, exploration, and nostalgic charm will likely find plenty to enjoy in Nonoly's adventure across the frozen kingdom.

Rating: 8/10
